execution_host.toolchain_note: The host system NVCC is 12.4; both conda/venv PyTorch wheels are cu130 builds reporting torch.version.cuda 13.0. NVCC and the PyTorch wheel CUDA runtime are separate layers and are not required to match.

environments.note: Quantization and serving intentionally use two separate pinned environments. The compressed-tensors MXFP4A16 artifact is a serialized checkpoint consumed by vLLM; it does not carry the llm-compressor runtime. Version differences across the two envs are by design, not a reproducibility defect, and each receipt records its own environment.

non_claims: This does not prove W4A4 MXFP4 tensor-core execution; Ampere uses Marlin W4A16 weight-only execution.
This does not prove quantization accuracy, BF16 parity, benchmark scores, serving throughput, or long-context stability.
The superseded text-only artifact must not be used because its tokenizer differs from the pinned source checkpoint.
The Transformers warning about the upstream Qwen pretokenizer regex remains observable in vLLM; this run intentionally preserves the pinned source tokenizer rather than applying a runtime rewrite.
